verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair capability to ask of an equity-management SaaS platform, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents user-defined rules that fire actions automatically on events. The material covers cap table management, vesting schedules, e-signing, reports and messaging, none of which is a rules engine or trigger system.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
